question: If $$\begin{bmatrix}x+y & 2x-y \\ z & x-z\end{bmatrix}=\begin{bmatrix}5 & 1 \\ 2 & 0\end{bmatrix},$$ find the values of $x$, $y$ and $z$.
explanation:
Equality of corresponding entries
From the equality of matrices, $$x+y=5,\quad 2x-y=1,\quad z=2,\quad x-z=0$$
Determination of $x$ and $y$
Adding the first two equations, $$3x=6\Rightarrow x=2$$
Then $x+y=5$ gives $y=3$.
Determination and verification of $z$
From $z=2$, we have $z=2$, and $x-z=2-2=0$, so the remaining entry also agrees.
Final values
$$x=2,\quad y=3,\quad z=2$$
